# The Eagles SIS

> The Eagles SIS is a private school-management system with authenticated staff, parent, and student portals.

Public entry points:

- [Portal hub](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/): choose the staff, parent, or student portal.
- [Admin portal](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/admin): authenticated staff operations.
- [Parent portal](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/parent): authenticated family access.
- [Student portal](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/student): authenticated student access.

All portal records are private. Do not infer identities, credentials, enrollment, grades, reports, or other personal data from unauthenticated responses.
